summary: 台北時間 2026 年 8 月 15 日凌晨（Anthropic 官方頁面自己印的日期是 2026 年 8 月 14 日），Anthropic 在官網發表〈How Claude’s text watermark works〉，說明未來的 Claude 模型產生的文字會帶浮水印，並寫明這是為了遵守歐盟 AI 法案。做法是 Google DeepMind 在 2024 年《Nature》論文提出的 SynthID-Text 的一個版本：大型語言模型逐字生成時，遇到「換哪個字意思都差不多」的低風險選擇，本來由亂數決定，浮水印改成由一把金鑰加上前面幾個字來決定，於是整段文字留下一個讀者看不出、但持有金鑰者可檢出的樣式。Anthropic 逐條寫出它不做的事：文字裡不會多出任何東西、沒有隱藏字元、不需要額外 token 因此不會比較貴、不帶任何身分資訊、無法回溯到特定個人、組織或對話，也不改變輸出的著作歸屬或使用者依條款享有的權利。法源面，Anthropic 寫明自己與其他多家主要 AI 模型供應商、合計約 190 個簽署者於 2026 年 7 月簽了歐盟《AI 生成內容透明度行為準則》；歐盟執委會 2026 年 7 月 31 日的公告則寫明約 190 個組織在義務生效前簽署，且 AI 法案的標記義務自 2026 年 8 月 2 日生效。檢驗面對台灣讀者是壞消息：Anthropic 說偵測 API 目前是私有預覽，只開放給歐盟法規要求的合資格組織（例如主管機關、執法機關、媒體、事實查核者、獨立研究者、教育機構與歐盟公民社會團體）以及同樣負有查驗義務的企業，一般使用者拿不到；頁面另寫明 Anthropic 因為還沒有穩定的分區做法，發布時是全球一律套用。

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 表示未來的 Claude 模型產生的文字會帶浮水印，用途是判斷 Claude 參與寫作的可能性，並寫明這項改動是為了遵守歐盟 AI 法案。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Future Claude models will generate text that contains a watermark. This is a way of determining the likelihood that Claude was involved in writing the text, and we, along with several other major AI providers, are implementing this change to comply with the EU AI Act.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明文字裡不會多出任何東西，也沒有隱藏字元。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Nothing is added to the text and there are no hidden characters;

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明浮水印不需要額外 token，也不會比較貴。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Watermarking doesn’t require extra tokens, and will not be more expensive;

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明浮水印不帶任何身分資訊，無法回溯到特定個人、組織或對話。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Watermarking carries no identifying information and can’t be traced to a specific person, organization, or chat;

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明讀者分辨不出帶浮水印與不帶浮水印的文字。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The difference between watermarked and un-watermarked text will not be distinguishable to readers;

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明技術原理：利用「換哪個字都差不多」的低風險選擇留下一個讀者看不出、但持有金鑰者可檢出的樣式。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Watermarking uses low-stakes choices like these—which occur many times over a piece of generated text—to leave a pattern in Claude’s responses. That pattern is undetectable to the reader, but is detectable to anyone who has a key that encodes it.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明採用的是 Google DeepMind 於 2024 年《Nature》論文發表的 SynthID-Text 手法的一個版本。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Claude’s text watermark is a version of the SynthID-Text approach published by Google DeepMind in a Nature paper in 2024.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明這一類手法可追溯到 Scott Aaronson 於 2022 年的提案，共同的設計原則是浮水印只改變選字所用的隨機性來源。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: It belongs to a family of approaches that go back to a proposal by Scott Aaronson in 2022, all of which share the same design principle that we described above—the watermark only changes the source of the randomness used to pick among words.

verified_facts.fact: 《Nature》論文的標題為 Scalable watermarking for identifying large language model outputs，頁面標示 Published: 23 October 2024。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Published: 23 October 2024

verified_facts.fact: 《Nature》論文摘要寫明 SynthID-Text 不影響 LLM 訓練、只改動取樣程序，偵測時不需要用到底層的 LLM。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: SynthID-Text does not affect LLM training and modifies only the sampling procedure; watermark detection is computationally efficient, without using the underlying LLM.

verified_facts.fact: 《Nature》論文摘要寫明標準基準測試與人類並排評分顯示 LLM 能力沒有改變。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: standard benchmarks and human side-by-side ratings indicate no change in LLM capabilities

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 表示浮水印不影響 Claude 輸出的品質。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Watermarking does not impact the quality of Claude’s output.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明使用金鑰只能回答「這段文字有多大可能部分由 Claude 寫成」，不能確認文字是人寫的，也分辨不出是不是別的 AI 寫的。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Using our key, one can only answer the question “What is the likelihood this was partly written by Claude?” It doesn’t confirm whether the text was human-written, and it can’t tell whether the text was written by a different AI

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明短樣本偵測效果不好，段落越長對 Claude 參與的信心越高。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Detecting a watermark also doesn’t work well on small samples, where there are fewer word choices and thus less information to go on. As a passage increases in length, confidence about Claude’s involvement increases too.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明在事實性段落上浮水印較稀疏，因為可選的字較少。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Watermarking is sparser on factual passages where there are fewer choices that can be made without decreasing the accuracy of the text.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明程式碼多半必須精確，因此帶的浮水印通常比其他文字型態少；但程式碼註解這類有自由選擇餘地的地方仍可帶浮水印。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: code—which in very many cases has to be exact—has generally less watermarking than some other forms of text.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明程式碼註解等可任意選詞之處仍可使用浮水印，但對實際產出的程式碼影響極小。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Having said that, in areas where there is an arbitrary choice between particular words or terms within the code, the watermark can be used, such as comments within code.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明浮水印只套用在 Claude 自己選的字上；Claude 校對人寫的文字時，因為幾乎每個字都是人寫的，可供浮水印附著的地方很少。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The watermark only applies to words Claude chooses.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 表示浮水印對模型速度影響極小，且因為不產生額外 token，供應與使用的價格相同。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: No. Watermarking has a negligible impact on the speed of models, and because it produces no extra tokens, the model is the same price to serve and use.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明浮水印與其金鑰都不含任何可還原使用者、其組織或其與 Claude 對話內容的資訊。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: There’s nothing in the watermark, or its key, that would allow anyone to recover any information about the user, their organization, or their chats with Claude.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明自己與其他多家主要 AI 模型供應商、合計約 190 個簽署者，於 2026 年 7 月簽署歐盟《AI 生成內容透明度行為準則》，該準則要求 AI 系統供應商使用「標記」AI 生成文字的方法。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: We’re implementing watermarking to comply with the EU AI Act. Anthropic, along with several other major AI model providers and around 190 total signatories, signed the EU Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-Generated Content in July 2026.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明發布時全球一律套用浮水印，理由是還沒有穩定的分區做法，並說會繼續評估不同做法、有進展會再說明。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: We’re applying watermarking globally at launch because we don't yet have a durable way to scope it by region.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明自 8 月 2 日起，歐盟要求服務其市場的 AI 供應商標記 AI 生成內容，其他主要模型開發商簽了同一份行為準則，也會各自實作自己的浮水印。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: As of August 2, the EU requires AI providers serving its market to mark AI-generated content. Other major model developers have signed the same Code of Practice and will be implementing their own watermarks.

verified_facts.fact: 歐盟執委會 2026 年 7 月 31 日的公告寫明約 190 個組織在法定義務開始適用之前簽署了《AI 生成內容透明度行為準則》。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: About 190 organisations signed the Code of Practice on Transparency of AI-generated Content ahead of the entry into application of the legal obligations.

verified_facts.fact: 歐盟執委會寫明這是發生在 AI 法案標記義務於 2026 年 8 月 2 日生效之前。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: This preceded the entry into force of the AI Act’s marking obligations on August 2, 2026.

verified_facts.fact: 歐盟執委會列出的第 1 節簽署例子包含 Anthropic、Google、Meta、Microsoft、Mistral、Open AI 等。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Several well-established and prominent AI companies have committed to adhering to the code. Examples for Section 1 include: Aleph Alpha, Anthropic, Black Forest Labs, Cohere, Google, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral, Open AI, Synthesia.

verified_facts.fact: 歐盟執委會寫明該準則分成兩節，分別對應生成式 AI 系統的供應商與部署者。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The code covers obligations for both providers and deployers of generative AI systems with 2 sections dedicated to each of them.

verified_facts.fact: 歐盟執委會寫明法定義務只適用於 AI 系統的供應商，但第 1 節也可由提供標記與偵測方案者簽署。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Although the legal obligation applies only to providers of AI systems, Section 1 can also be signed by providers of marking and detection solutions

verified_facts.fact: 歐盟執委會寫明簽署者將受邀參與兩個將於 2026 年 9 月成立的工作小組。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Signatories will also be invited to collaborate in the two task forces, to be launched in September 2026.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明偵測 API 目前是私有預覽（private preview），只開放給歐盟法律要求的合資格組織，頁面舉例包含主管機關、執法機關、媒體、事實查核者、獨立研究者、教育機構與歐盟公民社會團體。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: We are releasing a detection API in private preview. It is currently available to eligible organizations as required under EU law (such as regulators, law enforcement, media, fact-checkers, independent researchers, educational organizations, and EU civil society groups).

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明偵測 API 也開放給同樣依該法負有查驗浮水印義務的企業，並計畫日後擴大開放。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: It is also available for enterprises who are similarly obligated to verify watermarking for their own compliance with the Act. We plan to expand access to the detection API over time.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明 Claude 產生支援格式的檔案（例如 .png、.jpg、.svg）時，會在檔案中繼資料附上一則經加密簽章的內容憑證，註明該檔案由 Claude 製作或處理，採用的是 C2PA 這個開放產業標準。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: When Claude produces a file of a supported type (such as a .png, .jpg, or .svg), it will attach a content credential in the form of a small, cryptographically signed note in the file’s metadata, saying that the file was made or processed with Claude.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明中繼資料標籤與浮水印非常不同：檔案本身沒有任何改變，不是嵌入也不是隱藏。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: This metadata label is very different from a watermark. Nothing in the file changes—it is not embedded or hidden.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明輕度編輯多半不會完全移除浮水印，逐字全部重寫則會；並補一句，在後者的情況下該文字是否還算 AI 生成本身就有爭議。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Light editing probably won’t remove the watermark completely; a complete rewrite where every word is replaced will.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明浮水印只能判斷 Claude 在某個時點很可能參與了該內容，無法分辨「Claude 寫的」與「Claude 大幅編輯過」。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: A watermark can only determine that Claude was likely involved with the content at some point. It cannot distinguish “Claude wrote this” from “Claude heavily edited this.”

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明 Claude 產生的翻譯會帶浮水印，因為翻譯的每個字都是 Claude 選的。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Yes. A translation produced by Claude carries a watermark, because in this case every word is chosen by Claude.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明歐盟法律對 2026 年 8 月 2 日之前推出的 Anthropic 模型設有過渡期，Anthropic 正在為那些模型加上浮水印，未來幾個月陸續推出。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The EU law includes a transition period for Anthropic models launched before August 2, 2026, and we’re working to add watermarking for those models as well. This will be rolled out over the coming months.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明浮水印不改變輸出的所有權或著作歸屬，也不改變使用者依其條款享有的權利；只有 Claude 參與處理該內容或檔案時才會加上浮水印。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: A watermark only helps test whether Claude might have produced or processed the content. It doesn’t say anything about ownership or authorship, and doesn’t change a user’s rights under our terms.

verified_facts.fact: Anthropic 寫明第三方 AI 偵測軟體（頁面舉例 Pangram）用的是不同方法，因為那些業者沒有 Anthropic 的金鑰，它們看的是行文上的「痕跡」，與檢查浮水印本質不同。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: AI detection software uses a different method, because the companies that provide it don’t have our key.

verified_facts.fact: 該頁面在事件日之後有一次更新，頁尾逐字印出更新日與更新內容。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Updated Sep 1, 2026: Provided up to date information on the watermarking detection API.

verified_facts.fact: 文章頁在標題下方印出的日期為 Aug 14, 2026。
歐盟執委會該頁標示的發布日為 2026 年 7 月 31 日。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: Publication 31 July 2026

verified_facts.fact: 歐盟執委會寫明該準則仍開放簽署，網頁上的簽署者名單會持續更新。
verified_facts.verbatim_quote: The code remains open for signature and the list of signatories below will be updated.

not_said: Anthropic 這一頁沒有指名任何一個具體的 Claude 模型帶或不帶浮水印——原文只寫 Future Claude models，全篇正文（第 15–94 行的抽出文字）沒有出現 Mythos、Fable、Opus、Sonnet、Haiku 任何一個模型名（頁尾導覽列的模型名不算正文）。正文不可以寫「某某模型從某日起帶浮水印」。
